data.name: BidKing
data.detailed_description:
Major Announcement: Bid King's Official Release Date Revealed!

Future bid kings, thank you for your patience—

After countless rounds of refinement, sealed bids, lies, and psychological warfare, we're finally ready to make it official:

Bid King will officially launch on Steam on April 16!

Now you can:

✅ Add the game to your wishlist — Get notified the moment it launches and stay one step ahead.

✅ Bring your friends along — Let them feel the pain of being pushed into a higher bid and the thrill of landing a lucky find.

✅ Sharpen your acting skills — A smile, a sigh, a moment of fake hesitation... every expression can be a weapon.

There are no real friends in the auction house—only accomplices who haven't turned on you yet.

See you on Steam on April 16.

Follow us and join our community to stay up to date on the latest game news and updates!


About the Game

Welcome to Bid King—the ultimate auction showdown of wits and lies!

Core Gameplay: 4-Player Psychological Warfare

This is no ordinary auction game. In Sealed Bid Mode, every bid in a round is strictly confidential—you can't see anyone else's amount, so all you can do is guess, act, and bluff. In Standard Mode, visible bids are merely a facade for psychological warfare: is your opponent testing the waters or setting a trap? Is the player who suddenly raised the bid genuinely interested, or deliberately trying to drag you down?

Four collectors, but only one can have the last laugh.

Collector Skills: Everyone Has a "Special Ability"

Every collector has an untold past, and each one possesses unique information-gathering skills because of it:

Some can peek at an opponent's bidding range, as if using "X-ray vision."

Some can sense the true value of collectibles, helping them score accurate bargains.

Others can spread false information, bluffing their opponents into a trap.

Use your skills wisely and turn information asymmetry into your weapon. Remember: This isn't a game of luck; it's a gladiatorial arena for the wise.

Unboxing Collectibles: Surprises Emerging from the Fog

Winning the auction is when the real heart-pounding moment begins! The game features a "Gradual Collectible Reveal" mechanic—as the unboxing progresses, items emerge from the fog one by one.

One moment, you think you've ended up with nothing but a pile of scrap; the next, you're thrilled when a rare collectible appears out of nowhere. This emotional rollercoaster is exactly what makes the experience so thrilling.

Mind Games: Bidding Wars, Traps, and Crushing Your Opponents

Think winning the auction means winning the game? Think again. A true "Bid King" knows that making others lose money can be even more satisfying than making money yourself.

Deliberately spread false rumors to bait an opponent into paying top for a pile of junk, or raise the bid at a critical moment to saddle your rival with a costly mistake... Even if you take a small loss, as long as the other side suffers a crushing defeat, the match is worth it!

Your Collection: Every Collectible is a Trophy

The rare collectibles you secure at low prices will be added to your 3D digital collection cabinet, where you can admire them anytime. They're more than just impressive displays—they're trophies of your tactical skill.

data.short_description: Bid King is a multiplayer tactical strategy game of bid auctions and collectible appraisal. Read your rivals, judge through uncertainty, score valuable items at low prices, and bluff others into overpaying for junk. In this auction house of deception, only one thing matters: your wits.
